verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Public API, API & Webhooks on the pricing page, and an official MCP server, but nothing documents official SDKs or client libraries. A raw API or an MCP endpoint is an adjacent building block, not the SDK capability the story asks about. Building against official SDKs is a fair axis for a SaaS platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
